title: Free tier
snippet:
Every new Bright Data account gets **5,000 free credits per month** (~$7.50 value), usable across the Web Unlocker API, SERP API, Web Scraper API, Scraper Studio and Browser API. No credit card, no promo code, no commitment. **The Browser API is also included in the monthly free credits.** The Browser API consumes 5 credits per MB of traffic, so a full 5,000-credit allowance gives you nearly 1 GB of free Browser API traffic every month.
## What is the Bright Data free tier?
The free tier is a recurring monthly credit allowance that applies automatically to every new account. Credits renew on the first of each month and draw from a single shared pool, so you can spend them on any combination of the eligible products. The Web Unlocker API, SERP API and Web Scraper API cost one credit per request or record. Scraper Studio draws from the same pool and costs one credit per page load. The Browser API draws from the same pool at 5 credits per MB of traffic. Bright Data operates on a **pre-paid wallet model**: you are only ever charged for funds you have explicitly deposited. A free tier account has a hard stop when credits are exhausted, never a surprise bill.
## What can I use the free credits on?
| Product | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Web Unlocker API** | Retrieve any web page, bypassing anti-bot protections automatically. |
| **SERP API** | Extract structured search results from Google, Bing and more. |
| **Web Scraper API** | Get structured data from popular websites using pre-built, maintained scrapers. |
| **Scraper Studio** | Build and run custom scrapers in a cloud IDE or with an AI agent. One credit per page load, not per record. |
| **[Browser API](/products/scraping-browser/introduction)** | Run Puppeteer, Playwright or Selenium scripts on Bright Data’s cloud browsers with unblocking built in. Included at 5 credits per MB of traffic. |
Proxy products (Datacenter, ISP and Residential proxies) are **not** included in the monthly free credits. New accounts receive a separate one-time **$2 trial credit** (valid 7 days) to test the proxy products, plus an additional **$5 bonus** upon adding a payment method (valid 30 days).
## How are free credits consumed?
Free credits are drawn from a **single shared pool of 5,000 credits per account**. The Web Unlocker API, SERP API and Web Scraper API consume one credit per request or record. title: Bright Data vs SerpApi: SERP API Full Comparison with Benchmarks
snippet:
| **Free plan** | 5,000 monthly credits, with one credit per SERP request. No credit card required | 250 free searches per month, with throughput of up to 50 searches per hour |
| **Higher-volume pricing** | Pay as you go: $1.50 per 1,000 requests; Scale: 380K requests for $499/month, 900K for $999/month, or 2M for $1,999/month | Developer: $75 for 5,000 searches; Production: $150 for 15,000 searches; Big Data: $275 for 30,000 searches |

New Bright Data accounts get [5,000 monthly credits](https://docs.brightdata.com/general/account/billing-and-pricing/free-tier) across eligible products, including SERP API. One credit covers one SERP request, and you do not need a credit card to get started.
Bright Data’s [current SERP API plans](https://brightdata.com/pricing/serp) are:
| **Plan** | **Included usage** | **Price** |
|---|---|---|
| **Free tier** | 5,000 credits per month | Free |
| **Pay as you go** | Unlimited | $1.50 per 1,000 requests |
| **Scale** | 380,000 requests per month, then $1.30 per additional 1,000 | $499 per month |
| **Enterprise** | Custom volume | Custom pricing |
By default, you pay only for successful requests. Proxy management, unlocking, and parsing are included, with no bandwidth fees. For async jobs, the initial request is billed, and result retrieval is free.

SerpApi’s free plan includes 250 searches per month, with throughput up to 50 searches per hour. Paid monthly plans increase both the search allowance and hourly throughput:
| **Plan** | **Searches per month** | **Throughput per hour** | **Price per month** |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free** | 250 | 50 | $0 |
| **Starter** | 1,000 | 200 | $25 |
| **Developer** | 5,000 | 1,000 | $75 |
| **Production** | 15,000 | 3,000 | $150 |
| **Big Data** | 30,000 | 6,000 | $275 |

Bright Data combines recurring free credits and pay-as-you-go pricing with monthly tiers. SerpApi has a smaller free allowance and only monthly subscription-based plans.
| **Provider** | **Plan** | **Monthly searches or credits** | **Monthly fee** | **Price per 1,000 requests** | **Concurrency / throughput** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Bright Data** | Free | 5,000 shared credits | $0 | $0 | Unlimited |
| **Bright Data** | Pay as you go | Usage-based | N/A | $1.50 | Unlimited |
| **Bright Data** | Scale | 380K ($499); 900K ($999); 2M ($1,999) | N/A | $1.30; $1.10; $1.00 for additional requests | Unlimited |
| **SerpApi** | Free | 250 | $0 | $0 | 50 searches per hour |
| **SerpApi** | Starter | 1,000 | $25 | $25.
